description.value: The study examined neural systems supporting cognitive reappraisal in individuals with high versus normal trait anxiety using task fMRI.

spans.text: The current study aimed to add to the emerging literature on individual differences in the functioning of neural systems supporting emotion regulation, by characterizing differences between subjects with high and normal levels of trait anxiety.
